title: Freedoom + FastDoom (fully-libre Doom, 386)
notes: Fully-libre Doom end-to-end: GPL-2 engine + BSD-3 data, no proprietary IWAD. Runs on the i80386 tier (same machine that boots FreeDOS/Win3.0/commercial Doom here). Not executed in packaging (the proprietary AT/VGA BIOS ROMs every 386 boot needs are the user's to supply, never vendored). Engine and data are separately licensed; fetched, never re-hosted.
